---
title: "Gallery"
description: >
  Every article by its picture: a figure the article draws, or a preview of a
  table theme for the articles built on tables.
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Gallery}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

Each picture links to its article. A plot is the figure that article draws when
this site is built; an article built on tables shows a preview of a table theme
from the package.

```{r gallery}
# A figure is <article>_files/figure-html/<chunk label>-1.png, written when that
# article builds, so the chunk labels named here must not change. A theme preview
# is a man/figures file, which pkgdown publishes under reference/figures/. Both
# paths start with "../" so pkgdown does not look for them under vignettes/.
fig <- function(article, label) {
  sprintf("../articles/%s_files/figure-html/%s-1.png", article, label)
}
preview <- function(name) sprintf("../reference/figures/%s.png", name)

cards <- data.frame(
  article = c(
    "getting-started",
    "nfl-viz", "cfb-viz", "nba-viz", "wnba-viz", "mlb-viz", "nhl-viz", "mbb-viz", "wbb-viz",
    "social-posting", "leaderboard-dashboards", "reactable-integration", "workflows",
    "sdv-table-themes", "gt-toolkit",
    "styling", "saving_tables", "border_bars", "delay_tables", "grid_tables",
    "schedule_matrix", "tier_list", "window_wins",
    "neighbour-ranks", "shot-grid", "rolling-form", "signature-ribbon"
  ),
  title = c(
    "Getting Started",
    "NFL", "College Football", "NBA", "WNBA", "MLB", "NHL",
    "Men's College Basketball", "Women's College Basketball",
    "Social Posting", "Leaderboard Dashboards", "reactable Integration", "End-to-End Workflows",
    "SportsDataverse Table Themes", "Team Tables with the gt Toolkit",
    "Styling Headers, Legends and Captions", "Saving and Posting Tables", "Border Bars",
    "Percentile Bars and Cut Lines", "Faceted Tables", "Schedule Matrix", "Tier Lists",
    "Rolling-Window Wins",
    "Neighbour Ranks", "Shot Grid", "Rolling Form", "Signature Ribbon"
  ),
  image = c(
    fig("getting-started", "colors"),
    fig("nfl-viz", "epa-plot"), fig("cfb-viz", "playoff-bracket"),
    fig("nba-viz", "team-performance"), fig("wnba-viz", "team-performance"),
    fig("mlb-viz", "team-performance"), fig("nhl-viz", "team-performance"),
    fig("mbb-viz", "team-performance"), fig("wbb-viz", "team-performance"),
    fig("social-posting", "logo-scatter"), preview("gt_theme_pl"),
    preview("gt_theme_sofa_light"), fig("workflows", "cfb-workflow"),
    preview("gt_theme_sdv"), preview("gt_theme_sdv_dark"),
    preview("gt_theme_terminal"), preview("gt_theme_broadsheet"), preview("gt_theme_savant"),
    preview("gt_theme_almanac"), preview("gt_theme_swiss"), preview("gt_theme_scoreboard"),
    preview("tier_list_example"), preview("gt_theme_athletic"),
    preview("gt_theme_tufte"), fig("shot-grid", "plot"),
    preview("gt_theme_kenpom"), fig("signature-ribbon", "plot")
  )
)
# Every card has its own picture (checked below). Each picture sits inside a link whose text is the article title, so its alt text names only
# the kind of picture: a screen reader reads "Figure, NFL", not the title twice.
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(cards$image)) # a repeated picture fails the build
cards$alt <- ifelse(grepl("figure-html", cards$image), "Figure", "Table theme preview")

htmltools::div(
  class = "sdv-gallery",
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(cards)), function(i) {
    htmltools::a(
      class = "sdv-gallery-card",
      href = paste0(cards$article[i], ".html"),
      htmltools::img(src = cards$image[i], alt = cards$alt[i], loading = "lazy"),
      htmltools::span(cards$title[i])
    )
  })
)
```
